rationale: This changes canonical portability policy, CI enforcement and developer/product governance for strongly CUDA-oriented functions, but it does not add or modify an executable FA3/CFA3 host runtime, provider, model, package dependency, device driver, service, daemon, port/socket, credential delivery, hardware mutation, HRB lease path, accelerator backend implementation, or Current Host evidence collector. The runtime authorities and existing execution paths remain unchanged; therefore no physical Current Host requalification is required for this policy-only enforcement change. Any later material backend/provider implementation under this rule requires its own Current Host structural-impact assessment and physical requalification when runtime or host behavior changes.
